about: TravelGearRecs catalog (2026-10-31, approved by the owner): travel backpacks, rolling luggage, packing cubes, daypacks and slings, and travel accessories. Each exact name and URL was read on the maker's own store or product page. Sizes and generations are separate products (Travel Backpack 45L vs 30L, The Carry-On vs The Carry-On 3); fabric and colour editions are folded into the base product; packing cubes, pouches and adapters sold in several sizes on one page are one product. Columns: shape = category, core = capacity (only where the maker's name states it), balance = size class for luggage (from the name), weight and surface (material) not read. Blank = not read.
